summary: Full e2e verification of the new Travel vertical (iter221) across backend, web, and mobile. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (deals list/search/filter/sort, deal detail + 404, follow toggle, booking + orders, admin CRUD incl. 403 for non-admin and 400 on bad deal_type, feed-v2 shows TRAVEL_DEAL cards only while followed). Web: Shop → Travel entry link, /shop/travel list with 16 cards, follow toggle, type + sort chips, search, deal detail with travelers stepper and demo BigPoints Book → confirmation screen all work; home social feed renders 4 sf-card-TRAVEL_DEAL cards from 'FUUSIC Travel' with working 'View deal' CTA to /shop/travel/{id}; admin /admin/travel-deals page loads with 13 rows, sidebar link adnav-cq-travel-deals works, new/edit/delete testIDs present, create form opens. Mobile: shop-travel-entry under Shop tab routes to /shop/travel (travel-home-root), all type + sort chips + search + follow toggle work (13 cards; filter→2 flights), detail travelers inc/dec + travel-book-btn → travel-booking-confirmed; Social wall at /social (Home/together tab, mode=following) renders wall-card-TRAVEL_DEAL cards (4 from feed-v2) after scrolling with 'FUUSIC Travel' actor and Maldives content. Full web+mobile parity verified.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/travel.py admin_update (PUT /admin/deals/{id}) uses the full DealBody schema (not partial) — any admin UI edit must re-send all required fields (title, deal_type, destination, price_cents) or it will 422. Confirm the AdminTravelDeals form sends the full payload on edit (observed working, but future partial-edit features would need PATCH).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Travel vertical is fully functional end-to-end. Pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iter221_travel.py covers all critical backend flows (deals/follow/book/feed/admin) and should serve as regression. Mobile social wall uses FlatList virtualization — TRAVEL_DEAL cards appear only after scrolling; to assert programmatically, scroll `[tabindex]` scrollers to scrollHeight or click 'Load more' several times. Web admin PUT uses full DealBody (no PATCH).
